description: Local MCP server (PM-MCP) that takes over plan-marshall's process logic through a hypermedia-driven workflow: the server owns the plan state machine and answers with state plus pre-fabricated next tool calls. Currently a Quarkus application with a single hello MCP tool, shipped as a container image.
description_reasoning: README.adoc 'What is it?' section and CLAUDE.md project summary

documentation.description: AsciiDoc project documentation: the target-state concept for PM-MCP (architecture, hypermedia workflow, skill model, tool surface, build execution, container backend, security, technology, migration, test strategy) plus discussions of evaluated variants, and the LogMessages catalog for PM_MCP LogRecords.

guard-control-conformance-assembly.description: Fixture project, a pom template below src/guard-controls that BuildGuardsIT writes to target/guard-controls to prove that the enforcer executions of the root POM keep pm-conformance away from the classes of pm-mcp-server. It is not part of the product build.

guard-control-e2e-assembly-classes.description: Fixture project, a pom template below src/guard-controls that BuildGuardsIT writes to target/guard-controls to prove that the enforcer executions of the root POM keep pm-e2e away from the classes of pm-mcp-server. It is not part of the product build.

plan-marshall-mcp-parent.description: Maven aggregator/parent POM for the PM-MCP build: imports the Quarkus, token-sheriff and quarkus-mcp-server BOMs on top of cui-quarkus-parent and wires the coverage profile. Also carries the project-level documentation site.

pm-conformance.description: Behavioural conformance harness that drives live models over scenarios outside the regular build; it holds the vocabulary of verdicts, enforcement classes and attribution. It is a module of the build only with the profile conformance of the root POM, never part of verify, the integration tests or a required check.

pm-e2e.description: Release-shape end-to-end tests over the four native binaries (pm-mcpd, pm-mcp, pm-operator, pm-exec): the release layout, the STDIO relay harness and a job chain run as processes. It holds tests only and takes the client binaries from a checkout of pm-mcp-clients.

pm-mcp-server.description: Quarkus assembly of the always-on daemon pm-mcpd: it wires the engine and runtime modules of pm-mcp-core into the MCP server on a Unix socket, the token identity and request security, the local runtime API, the credentials resource and the optional web listener. It holds wiring only; logic that needs no framework type belongs in pm-mcp-core.

name: plan-marshall-mcp
